text:
incident-bot: 🚨 PagerDuty alert: High 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway-prod. 5xx rate = 12x baseline over 3m window. Affected region: us-east1. Suggested runbook: check gateway pods, autoscaler, gateway logs, and routing fallbacks. Paging @ops-rotation and @beth-sre. PD incident: INC-20274

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-20274 triggered and assigned to ops-rotation. Trigger rule: `gateway_5xx_rate > 10x`.

ops-rotation: acked. I'm on it, switching to #incidents-voice for immediate comms. Can someone post the quick snapshot (pods, target cpu, queue depth)?

alex: seeing 502/503 across many ingress pods. Quick `kubectl get hpa -n platform inference-gateway` shows current replicas 6 -> desired 2 (weird). autoscaler might be thrashing.

neha: logs show a lot of backend timeouts in the gateway: `upstream read timeout` and `connection reset by peer`. Also noticing massive burst of long-tail requests from a single customer IP block.

beth-sre: grabbing metrics: rolling 5m: error_rate% = 8.7 -> up from 0.6. p95 latency spiking. KVCACHE eviction rate also high. Tagging `impact:customer-visible`.

ops-rotation: running runbook step 1: check node saturation. `kubectl top pods -n platform | grep inference-gateway` -> CPU 95% on 4 pods, memory normal. Disk i/o low.

melissa: PD shows auto-remediation attempted: autoscaler tried to scale to 12 but failed due to quota/eviction errors. There are repeated `failed to provision` events in cluster autoscaler logs.

alex: looks like we hit a scale ceiling. Also network connectivity to backend pool is flaky (TCP resets). I'm going to enable fallback routing to dedicated capacity for new requests.

neha: recommended mitigation: 1) enable fallback to dedicated model variant (route ~30% traffic), 2) manually increase HPA max from 12 -> 20 if quota allows, 3) temporarily throttle noisy customer IPs at the edge.

ops-rotation: executing step 2: `kubectl patch hpa inference-gateway -n platform -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":20}}'` — patched. Requesting cluster admins to approve immediate node quota bump if needed.

incident-bot: Action logged: HPA maxReplicas updated by ops-rotation.

beth-sre: enabling fallback routing via feature flag: `rbac route set inference-gateway -> dedicated-pool weight=30%` (pseudocode). Will monitor error rate.

alex: temporary NACL applied to block offending IP CIDR: `iptables -A INPUT -s 203.0.113.0/24 -j DROP` at the edge allowlist. That reduced inbound QPS from that source by ~78%.

melissa: cluster autoscaler just logged: `Sufficient quota granted; launching 4 nodes` — node creation in progress.

ops-rotation: seeing immediate improvement: 5xx rate dropped from 12x to ~3x over last 2 minutes. p95 latency improving. Continued monitoring for 15m.

pagerduty: Update: Incident INC-20274 acknowledged by ops-rotation (@ops-rotation). Escalation not required currently.

neha: note for customer impact: we've flagged 4 high-tier customers in us-east1 for possible degraded responses. Recommending outreach if error rates persist beyond 30m.

beth-sre: runbook next steps: collect core dumps/log bundles from affected gateway pods, snapshot HPA and CA logs, and export a sample set of failing requests for evaluation. `kubectl logs -n platform inference-gateway-abc --since=15m > /tmp/gateway-fail.log`

alex: started a short-lived canary rollback to previous gateway image to rule out recent deploy as cause. No deploys in the last 2h though.

ops-rotation: CA nodes are now healthy, autoscaler settled at 14 replicas, traffic routing holding with 30% on dedicated. Error rate stable at ~1.1x baseline. I'm going to start a controlled scale down once we see 15m stable.

melissa: PD note added: `Mitigation: manual HPA max bump + fallback routing + IP throttle. Customer impact: intermittent 502/503 in us-east1 for some high-volume clients; mitigation applied. Next: postmortem + quota review.`

neha: tagging customers in case notes: CustomerA, CustomerC — they reported intermittent 5xx via support.

ops-rotation: unassigning PD incident for now, keeping thread open. If anybody else sees regressions, ping @ops-rotation. I'll create a follow-up ticket: `INC-20274-FIX` for root cause analysis (HPA thrash + CA quota limits + noisy client).

beth-sre: quick checklist for postmortem: 1) why did autoscaler fail to provision earlier? 2) why HPA desired < observed requests? 3) KV cache eviction correlation with error spike.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20274 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Channel: incidents.

ops-rotation: closing voice bridge. Will post a short incident summary in ~1hr with timelines and logs. Thanks all :thumbsup:

melissa: adding retention note and tagging finance for possible dedicated pool overage costs during mitigation.

alex: one more: config snapshot saved at `/artifacts/INC-20274/snapshot-1749992222.tar.gz` for postmortem.

ops-rotation: last check: p95 latency and 5xx rate within SLOs for 5m window. Marking last_message_ts = 1749992800.
